producerKinds.description: A model-backed review agent produced the observation.
A deterministic tool or rule produced the observation.
An adapter imported the observation from a legacy contract.
The producer cannot be established from the available facts.

evidenceStatuses.description: All evidence required by the review profile is available.
Some, but not all, evidence required by the review profile is available.
The required evidence could not be obtained.

assessments.description: The evidence establishes conformance for the assessed scope.
The evidence establishes a concern without establishing failure.
The evidence establishes non-conformance for the assessed scope.
The available evidence does not support a conclusive assessment.
The assessment does not apply to the subject.
The subject is applicable but has not yet been assessed.

changes.description: The comparison establishes both improvements and regressions.
The compared quality state is unchanged.
No quality delta was observed in the comparison evidence.
The available evidence does not support a conclusive change direction.

decisions.description: The referenced policy permits the subject to proceed.
The referenced policy permits the subject with a warning.
The referenced policy prevents the subject from proceeding.
The referenced policy defers a disposition until more evidence or authority is available.

severities.description: Immediate action is required because impact is critical.
Prompt action is required because impact is high.
Action is required because impact is material but bounded.
The impact is limited and can be scheduled normally.
The item is informational and does not assert a defect.

lifecycles.description: The issue is active and has no superseding disposition.
An authorized actor accepted the issue risk.
An authorized actor temporarily waived the issue under stated conditions.
An authorized actor determined that the issue does not represent the claimed defect.
Evidence under an explicit reconciliation policy establishes that the issue is resolved.

evidenceKinds.description: A source location or source artifact supports the observation.
A test execution result supports the observation.
A runtime measurement supports the observation.
A structured tool result supports the observation.
A retained artifact supports the observation.
A human attestation supports the observation.

aspects.title: Architecture
aspects.description: Architecture and dependency-direction quality of code.

aspects.title: Security
aspects.description: General security quality not represented by a narrower core aspect.

aspects.title: Input validation
aspects.description: Validation and normalization at trust boundaries.

aspects.title: Configuration and infrastructure as code
aspects.description: Security of configuration and infrastructure definitions.

aspects.title: Boundary exposure
aspects.description: Exposure and protection of externally reachable boundaries.

aspects.title: Business logic security
aspects.description: Security of stateful business rules and multi-step flows.

aspects.title: Attack coverage
aspects.description: Assessment coverage of applicable attack classes.

aspects.title: Change risk
aspects.description: Risk introduced or removed by a change.

aspects.title: Test evidence
aspects.description: Adequacy of test evidence for a change.

aspects.title: Scope discipline
aspects.description: Alignment of a change with its stated scope.

aspects.title: Architecture drift
aspects.description: Architecture drift introduced or removed by a change.
